selection_note: Six candidate questions; source packets and independent review are pending. Do not use these candidates for tuning.

questions.text: How should an adsorption study distinguish changes in equilibrium uptake from changes in equilibration time when temperature is varied, and which controls would make the proposed comparison interpretable?
How can a fluorescence-quenching study distinguish static and dynamic quenching from an inner-filter artifact, and what evidence must support each proposed diagnostic?
How should a monthly return-forecasting study separate genuine predictive information from look-ahead leakage and overlapping-label dependence in its validation design?
How can an empirical study distinguish volatility spillover between two markets from their shared exposure to a common factor, and which assumptions would limit the conclusion?
How should a numerical study separate discretization error from boundary-approximation error when testing convergence of a finite-difference solution to a diffusion equation?
How should a Monte Carlo study check uncertainty estimates when simulated observations are dependent, and how can it distinguish a central-limit approximation from a finite-sample guarantee?
